full_prompt_en: A square editorial studio photograph shows a young adult man with curly brown hair and a short full beard facing the camera against a dark warm-gray background. The backdrop has a faint mottled gradient and no objects or readable text, allowing the head and shoulders to dominate. His loose curls rise above the forehead and spread outward at the sides, with individual strands catching a subdued rim of light. Clear blue-gray eyes look directly outward beneath natural brows, and a relaxed closed mouth gives the portrait a quiet, confident expression. The beard and mustache are carefully resolved, with warm brown and dark amber strands framing the lower face. He wears a charcoal jacket with a subtly textured surface over a darker vest and a pale, slightly open-collared shirt. Small buttons and seams are visible but restrained, adding shape rather than spectacle. The shoulders form a broad dark base at the lower edge, and the torso is cropped before the waist. Soft frontal light comes from the upper left, brightening the forehead, eye area, nose bridge, and left cheek while the right cheek and jacket fall into gentle shadow. A secondary faint edge light separates some curls from the dark background. Skin retains natural texture without harsh retouching, and the jacket has a low matte sheen. Warm browns, charcoal, gray, and pale cream hold the image in a narrow, refined palette. The overall composition is centered and uncluttered, using intimate eye contact and subtle tonal modeling for an approachable professional mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形编辑式影棚照片描绘一名卷棕发、留短而丰厚胡须的年轻成年男子，正对镜头，背景是深暖灰色。背景只有淡淡斑驳渐变，没有物件或可读文字，让头与双肩占据主导。松散卷发在额头上方升起，向两侧展开，单根发丝接住低调的轮廓光。清澈蓝灰色眼睛在自然眉毛下直视外侧，放松闭合的嘴赋予肖像安静自信的表情。胡须和上唇须描绘清楚，暖棕与深琥珀色发丝框住下半脸。他穿一件带细微肌理的炭色夹克，里面是更深的背心和略敞领的浅色衬衫。小纽扣与接缝可见，却很克制，只为塑造形状而不抢眼。双肩在下缘形成宽阔深色基座，躯干在腰部以上被裁掉。柔和正面光从左上方进入，照亮额头、眼周、鼻梁和左颊，右颊与夹克则落入温和阴影。一线次要弱轮廓光把部分卷发与深色背景分开。皮肤保留自然肌理，没有强烈修饰，夹克光泽低而哑。暖棕、炭色、灰和浅奶油色把影像保持在狭窄精致的色域内。整体构图居中且简洁，借亲近的眼神交流和微妙色调塑形形成平易的专业氛围。
style_prompt_en: The image has a refined editorial-photography finish with close framing, natural skin detail, and soft studio modeling. Charcoal and warm gray carry broad quiet areas, while amber-brown and pale cream mark the focal texture and highlights. Light arrives from the upper front side, smoothly shaping rounded planes and leaving gentle shadow rather than hard contrast. A faint rim separates dark edges from the backdrop. The background is matte, mottled, and slightly out of focus, so finely resolved focal texture remains prominent. Broad lower dark masses support a centered luminous upper form. The overall effect is intimate, composed, and quietly polished.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有精致编辑摄影质感，采用贴近裁切、自然皮肤细节与柔和影棚塑形。炭色和暖灰承载宽阔安静区域，琥珀棕与浅奶油色标出焦点肌理和高光。光从上方前侧进入，平顺塑造圆润平面，留下温和阴影而非坚硬反差。一线弱轮廓光把深色边缘与背景分开。背景哑光、斑驳且略失焦，使精细焦点肌理凸显。下部宽阔深色体量承托上方居中的明亮形态。整体效果亲密、沉着且安静地精致。
theme_en: A softly lit editorial portrait of a curly-haired man
theme_zh: 卷发男子的柔光编辑肖像
name: Advertising portrait
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
